title: Octopuses Are Basically Aliens

scenes.narration: This animal has three hearts, blue blood, and nine brains.
Meet the octopus. Two of its hearts pump blood to the gills, and the third pumps it to the rest of the body.
Its blood is blue because it uses copper instead of iron to carry oxygen.
Each of its eight arms has its own mini brain, so an arm can keep exploring even when the main brain is busy.
And it can change color in less than a second, even though scientists believe it is color blind.
Which fact surprised you most? Follow for more weird animal facts.

caption: Octopuses are way stranger than you think. Which fact blew your mind?
